about:
A research-driven academic and Artificial Intelligence professional with a strong foundation in scientific research, teaching, academic leadership, and intelligent systems development. Specialized in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Generative AI, Large Language Models and Information Retrieval 

Research experience encompasses scholarly publications, algorithm development, computational modeling, experimental design, model optimization, and performance evaluation. Contributions include intelligent question answering, semantic information retrieval, language understanding, and advanced data-driven applications.

A multidisciplinary professional background combines international research experience, university-level teaching, academic administration, student mentorship, and collaborative innovation. Technical capabilities include Python programming and the development of intelligent chatbots, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and analytical solutions.

Committed to advancing scientific knowledge, fostering interdisciplinary collaboration, supporting high-quality education, and translating research into meaningful solutions to real-world challenges.
